weekly_theme.summary: 太陽剛進入天秤座不久，生活重心可能悄悄轉往天秤座相關的主題與氣氛。

aries.horoscope: 白羊座，今天對你來說有很大的潛力！你在靈性旅程和職業生涯中的願望都很美好，讓你能夠在不犧牲其中一方的情況下培養兩者。這是一個非凡的平衡請留意是否有機會將您的信念付諸行動，這可能是由朋友或同事提出的。對所有建議保持開放的心態，因為其中一個建議可能會解開協調您生活中這些重要方面的祕訣。
aries.horoscope_en: Today holds great potential for you, Aries! Your aspirations in both your spiritual journey and career are aligning beautifully, allowing you to nurture both without sacrificing one for the other. It's a remarkable balance. Be on the lookout for a chance to put your beliefs into action, likely presented by a friend or coworker. Keep an open mind to all suggestions, as one of them may unlock the secret to harmonizing these vital aspects of your life.

taurus.horoscope_en: Tonight, Taurus, let your natural charm shine through! You might find yourself in conversation with someone who could play a pivotal role in your career. Trust your instincts; you may recognize this person right from the start. If the connection feels right, that's even more promising! Regardless of whether this encounter leads to romance or professional growth, you'll look back on this evening as a turning point for the better!

gemini.horoscope_en: Gemini, your reflective side is shining through. Over the past few weeks, you've been evaluating what aspects of your life are thriving and which ones are falling short. It seems you're on the brink of a significant transformation. Whether it's your relationship feeling stagnant or a desire for a total career shift, trust your intuition as you chart your path forward. Remember, you are your own greatest advisor.

cancer.horoscope_en: Cancer, you're on the brink of embracing fresh experiences! With the current planetary movements, it's the perfect moment to turn your dreams into reality. You might contemplate starting your own venture or even shifting from one relationship to another. You're craving bold and significant transformations! If you hold back now, it could be a while before you feel this vibrant and hopeful energy again.

leo.horoscope_en: Today is a day for deep introspection. Take a moment to evaluate your accomplishments and the aspirations that remain unfulfilled. As you look back over the past few months, be truthful with yourself. Consider whether there were alternative paths you could have taken and if you wish to approach things differently moving forward. It would be beneficial to jot down both your achievements and your disappointments. This list will serve as a valuable guide to help you stay focused and motivated.

virgo.horoscope_en: Today marks a moment of renewal, offering you the opportunity to embark on a fresh journey. A sense of excitement and optimism fills the air as you look ahead. Your objectives are well-defined, and your thoughts are focused. Success seems inevitable! However, be cautious not to let your imagination lead you astray. Stay grounded and concentrate on realistic aspirations instead of getting lost in unattainable dreams.

libra.horoscope_en: Libra, it seems you’re on the brink of significant shifts in your professional life. The pressures and extended hours of the corporate world might be wearing you down. In this tech-savvy era, there are certainly options to enhance your work-life balance without compromising your productivity. Take a few days to contemplate this. If you present a well-thought-out alternative to your supervisor, you might be pleasantly surprised by their reaction.

scorpio.horoscope_en: Today, Scorpio, your intuition is heightened, allowing you to tap into the profound emotions of those around you. The cosmic energies are encouraging openness and honesty, inspiring everyone to embrace their true selves, and you’re no exception. Carve out a moment in your hectic day to ponder both your past regrets and achievements. Strive to be as genuine as you can.

Take stock of your recent accomplishments and consider any goals that remain unfulfilled. If your reflections leave you wanting, it may be time for a significant shift. If your current job doesn't ignite your passion, seek out one that does. Remember, life is not a practice run—take action!

pisces.horoscope_en: Today, Pisces, your romantic connection is set to flourish like never before. The lines of communication are open, and you both are attuned to each other's emotions. It's truly a blessing to nurture such an uplifting and fulfilling relationship with someone who cares deeply for you. Take a moment to appreciate all the positives in your partnership. This might be the perfect opportunity to elevate your relationship further, and your partner will be open to having that conversation.
